days.brief: Kambalda and Pinjarra lead the way today: sunny, around 28° with a gentle breeze. The set-up: high pressure over the south-west is keeping things settled and dry, with mostly light winds, while a cold front brings a few showers to the far south and an inland trough keeps the interior hotter and more unsettled. Bridgetown, Collie and Harvey are not far behind. Least appealing: Balgo Hill, with 41° heat.

Denmark and Mount Barker lead the way tomorrow: partly cloudy, around 25° with a gentle breeze. The set-up: high pressure over the south-west is keeping things settled and dry, with mostly light winds, while a cold front brings a few showers to the far south and an inland trough keeps the interior hotter and more unsettled. Jerramungup, Ravensthorpe and Salmon Gums are not far behind. Least appealing: Northampton, with 43° heat.

Cocklebiddy is the pick of WA on Monday: cloud clearing, 29° with a gentle breeze. Walpole, Yallingup and Windy Harbour are not far behind. On the coast the sea breeze should reach Walpole by about 2 pm, taking the edge off the afternoon. Least appealing: Murchison, with 41° heat and maybe a storm.
Bridgetown is the pick of WA on Tuesday: cloud clearing, 25° with a gentle breeze. Boyup Brook, Harvey and Pinjarra are not far behind. Least appealing: Wiluna, with 42° heat.
Bridgetown and Collie lead the way on Wednesday: partly cloudy, around 26° with light winds. Mount Barker, Jerramungup and Kalamunda are not far behind. Least appealing: Warburton, with 41° heat.

Ellenbrook and Midland lead the way on Thursday: partly cloudy, around 27° with a gentle breeze. Kalamunda, Eucla and Armadale are not far behind. Least appealing: Warburton, with 42° heat and strong winds.
Manjimup and Pemberton lead the way on Friday: cloud clearing, around 29° with light winds. Mount Barker, Jerramungup and Ravensthorpe are not far behind. Least appealing: Warburton, with 42° heat.
